rewind.recordHistoryMissing: "{{tableName}}" cannot be fully restored: {{count}} rows have aged out of history. The rewind has stopped and data is unchanged. Suggested actions: (1) pick a more recent restore point, or (2) ask your admin to restore from backup if you must use this point.

field.typeConvertFailed: Could not change "{{fieldName}}" from {{oldType}} to {{newType}}: row {{rowNo}} value "{{sample}}" cannot be converted. The change has been reverted. Suggested actions: (1) export the column and clean it externally; (2) use "Bulk update" to normalize bad values first; (3) ask an admin to help handle the {{count}} affected rows.
field.renameConflict: Cannot rename "{{oldName}}" to "{{newName}}": a field with that name already exists, or it is referenced by {{count}} linked field(s). Check "Field dependencies" first, or pick a different name.
field.deleteReferenced: "{{fieldName}}" cannot be deleted: it is referenced by {{count}} linked field(s). Remove the dependents first, or check "Field dependencies" before deciding.
field.primaryFieldDeleteForbidden: Cannot delete "{{fieldName}}": it is the primary field. Deleting it directly may corrupt existing data or related columns. Change the primary field in table settings first.

deleteImpactDialog.warningHigh: This field is referenced by other fields or views; deleting it will break downstream fields. We recommend reviewing the full chain in "Field dependencies" before continuing.
deleteImpactDialog.warningMedium: This field is referenced by some views; those view configurations will be cleaned up automatically after delete.
deleteImpactDialog.warningLow: This field has no downstream dependents and can be safely deleted.
deleteImpactDialog.noImpactSafe: Delete field "{{name}}"? It has no downstream dependents, so it's safe to remove. See the hint below to learn whether this delete is undoable.
deleteImpactDialog.undoSimpleHint: Undoable: press Ctrl+Z (⌘Z) right after delete to restore the field and its history structure.
deleteImpactDialog.undoComplexHint: Undoable: press Ctrl+Z (⌘Z) right after delete to restore the field. The dependency graph will be rebuilt and values recomputed automatically (may take a few seconds). If a required dependency field has been deleted, you'll see a specific error message.
deleteImpactDialog.undoNotInWaveHint: Cannot be undone: this field type is not in the quick-undo allowlist this release. To recover, restore from "Version history" or contact your organization admin.
deleteImpactDialog.undoUnknownHint: Cannot be undone: unknown field type. Please contact your organization admin.
deleteImpactDialog.fetchErrorFallback: Failed to load dependency analysis. You can still continue with the delete, but please verify the table state immediately afterwards.

batchRestore.title: Some fields could not be undone in this step
batchRestore.summary: In this undo step: {{restorableCount}} simple field(s) can be restored individually with Ctrl+Z; {{unrestorableCount}} complex field(s) need to be restored from "Version history".
batchRestore.complexFieldHint: Some system-managed fields require restoring from version history.

table.deleteReferenced: "{{tableName}}" cannot be deleted: {{skillCount}} Skill(s) and {{viewCount}} cross-table view(s) depend on it. Forcing delete will break those Skills or empty those views. Check "Field dependencies", or archive the table first to let dependents migrate.

trashedBanner.title: "{{tableName}}" moved to trash
trashedBanner.description: Background calculations are stopped; Skill rules and cross-table views that depend on this table are auto-paused. You can restore the table from "Organization settings · Resource Trash" within 30 days.

deletedBanner.title: "{{tableName}}" deleted
deletedBanner.description: All background calculations on this table are stopped, and Skill rules / cross-table views that depend on it are paused. The table cannot be restored after permanent delete; contact your organization admin to recover historical data from backup if needed.

bulk.checkpointCreating: AI action on "{{tableName}}" affects {{count}} rows. Creating an auto restore point... Once ready, you can "Undo this AI action" with one click from the chat.
bulk.quotaExceeded: This update will consume {{tokens}} organization tokens, exceeding the remaining {{remaining}}. Preflight stopped; data is unchanged. Suggestions: (1) narrow the filter; (2) wait for monthly quota reset; (3) ask your organization admin to upgrade.

updateByFilter.riskLowDesc: Few rows affected; safe to proceed.
updateByFilter.riskMediumDesc: {{count}} rows affected. A restore point will be created automatically.
updateByFilter.checkpointHint: A restore point will be created; you can rewind anytime
updateByFilter.preflightFailed: Bulk update preflight failed: {{reason}}. Data is unchanged. Please try again later; contact your organization admin if it keeps failing.
updateByFilter.commitFailed: Bulk update commit failed: {{reason}}. Data is unchanged. Please try again later; contact your organization admin if it keeps failing.
updateByFilter.rejectedDesc: {{count}} rows matched, exceeding the 10,000-row single update limit. Narrow the filter to process in smaller batches, or contact an admin.
updateByFilter.driftWarning: Actual updated rows differ from preflight by {{ratio}}% (expected {{expected}}, actual {{actual}}). Please verify your data.

view.filterInvalid: This view's filter is no longer valid: the referenced "{{fieldName}}" field was deleted. The view now shows all records without filtering. Open view settings to reconfigure.

record.concurrentEditConflict: This record was just modified by {{collaboratorName}}: your changes are not saved yet. Your input is preserved — refresh to continue editing on the latest version, or click "I confirm, overwrite" to force-save.
record.restoreConflict: Cannot restore this record to its original location: {{reason}}. Continuing may create duplicate or misaligned data. Verify the latest structure in the table, or use "Duplicate as new row" instead.

import.fieldUnmapped: Import preflight found {{count}} columns without target field mapping (e.g. "{{exampleColumn}}"). These columns will be ignored without affecting others. Map them explicitly in "Field mapping", or check "Ignore unmapped columns" to continue.
import.failed: Import failed at row {{rowNo}}: column "{{columnName}}" {{expected}}, but the file has "{{actualValue}}". The import has stopped; rows already imported follow the latest hint. Fix the cell or column mapping and re-import; for large issues, try a smaller file.

undo.failed: Cannot undo the last action: {{reason}}. The table contents remain unchanged. Refresh and try again; if it still fails, you can try recovering from version history.

fieldRecycleBin.title: Deleted Fields
fieldRecycleBin.description: Deleted fields within the retention period can be restored here. Fields are permanently removed after {{days}} days.
fieldRecycleBin.loadFailed: Failed to load. Please retry later.
fieldRecycleBin.ttlHint: Deleted fields are retained for {{days}} days, then permanently removed.
